|game4= arma3
|version4= 0.50

|gr1= GUI Control

|descr= Sets progress position of a [[CT_PROGRESS|progress bar]].

|s1= control [[progressSetPosition]] progress

|p1= control: [[Control]] - progress bar control

|p2= progress: [[Number]] - 0: no progress; 1: full progress

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>_control progressSetPosition 0.5;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>
with uiNamespace do {
	bar = findDisplay 46 ctrlCreate ["RscProgress", -1];
	bar ctrlSetPosition [0,0,1,0.01];
	bar ctrlCommit 0;
	bar progressSetPosition 0.75;
};
</sqf>

|seealso= [[progressPosition]] [[ctrlSetScrollValues]] [[sliderSetPosition]]
